info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Payment Rail Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Payment Rail Operation Status API provides access to the statuses of various payment rail operations. It enables businesses to monitor and retrieve the current status of payment transactions across different rail systems. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors who need real-time updates to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. By leveraging this API, users can ensure timely responses to inquiries related to payment processing, thus enhancing overall transaction management.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of payment rail operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of various payment rail operations. It provides insights into operational metrics and helps identify any potential issues within the payment systems in real-time.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the status of payment rail operations. This request body structure must adhere to the specified JSON schema, which outlines the required properties for successful operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning current payment rail operation status.

ListPaymentRailOperationStatusRequest.description: A request body schema that represents the status of operations in payment rail operations.
